translations: We will remove from you your evil deeds
and We will admit you (to) an entrance noble
puzzle.hint: This verse promises forgiveness and an honorable entry for those who abstain from major sins.
puzzle.arabic: إِن تَجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَبَآئِرَ مَا تُنْهَوْنَ عَنْهُ نُكَفِّرْ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَنُدْخِلْكُم مُّدْخَلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا
puzzle.verseEn: If you avoid the major sins which you are forbidden, We will remove from you your lesser sins and admit you to a noble entrance [into Paradise].
